name: Fried Ice Cream
body:
Station and Complexity friturier 6, line cook 4, patissier 4

Flavor Profiles sweet, texture, temperature, temperature
Additional Ingredients sweet, temperature, or texture

EFFECT

Duration 1 round/level; Serving Size 1d6
Saving Throw Fortitude half

DESCRIPTION

Fried ice cream is prepared by dipping scoops of ice cream in a batter (egg, flour, water), freezing them, and then quickly frying them before they can melt.

When consumed, fried ice cream deals 1d6 damage per level (maximum 15d6). Half of this damage is cold and the other half is fire.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1 and the damage by +1d6 each.
